Decisions

  • Where in the lead? Put them directly under the lead card (after the resting line), as one stack with a 12 px gap, before Bibliotek.
  • Add a fix link to the ramp notice? No. The content is out of scope, and the only links today (/settings/profile and the band sessions) work from anywhere. A deep link from each ramp line to its phase in Avansert is a follow-up: it needs phase anchors and open-on-hash.
  • Hierarchy inside a notice? The fact lines are foreground and the explanation stays muted-foreground, so the lead says what the warning is before why. The words do not change.
  • 44 px links inside a sentence? Use an invisible ::after hit area (−13 px, or −14 px from md), not inline-flex min-h-11. The second leaves a 20 px gap in the middle of a sentence (probe below).
  • Live region? No. The notices get role="note", not Alert's role="alert". In the lead they mount on every visit, so a screen reader would read all three out loud each time (critic, build must).
  • Close-button gutter? Only the first line clears the ×, instead of 72 px all the way down. That cuts 240 px off the worst case at 390 (critic, build must).
  • Unbounded band lines? They ship as they are. Grouping them per block is a follow-up, because content is out of scope (critic).
Appendix

Critic's scoring (Playwright at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 px; probes critic-probe.mjs and critic-probe-padding.mjs; full notes in critic.md):

1 Ramp in lead, no tapholds: first under the card, unchanged copy. Starts at 653 px worst case at 390; at 320×700 it needs a scroll, not a tap.
2 Availability, bandholds: both in the stack, with no-capacity, clashes and four sessions.
3 Onceholds: with Avansert open, 3 on the page and 0 in Blokker.
4 Dismiss, back next visitholds: 3 → 2, focus moves to the sr-only line, and a reload brings back 3.
5 None: nothingholds: no stack, and the lead bottom matches today's.
6 Not-active planholds by construction (one loader season). The build adds route tests for ?outline= and ?event=.
7 Fix linksholds: /settings/profile and the session links work from anywhere. No link goes into Avansert yet.
8 390: overflow, 44 px, textholds: overflow 0 at 320, 390, 768, 1440 and 200 %. Targets measure 44–45 px. The ::after areas never overlap, and every glyph box hits its own link. Text is 16 / 14 px.
9 Copyholds: unchanged, from labels/sesong.ts.

Craft: fact lines in foreground, the ::after links and no motion on dismiss are all right. Two must change: role="alert" and the full-height 72 px gutter. Follow-up: the resting line's "Åpne løpsplanen" still uses min-h-11 and keeps its 20 px mid-sentence gap, directly above the new stack.

Fit: ADR 0101 §2 now reads: plan, then its warnings, then Bibliotek and Avansert. It matches I dag, where the Autopilot Notice follows the today card (§3). A fourth guard lands in the same PlanGuardNotices slot. The readings stay in Avansert.

Designer's pick: Under the card. It agrees with the critic, so there is no disagreement.

Method: Emil's prototype (standalone branch). One self-contained HTML file uses the project's tokens and Public Sans. The real copy comes from the repo's own labels.ts and format.ts functions, run with tsx (gen-copy.ts → copy.json). Playwright measured overflow, tap targets, text size, the fold and dismissal (shoot.mjs → measure.json). I did not run the real app: the checkout is read-only for this run, and seeding needs writes. The curve is an approximation of SeasonCurveView.

Settled by probe: "Do 44 px inline links survive in a sentence?" I rendered inline-flex min-h-11: it opened a 20 px gap in the middle of the line. An ::after at −10 px measured 39 px, because the inline box is the font's content area (~19 px), not the 24 px line. At −13 px / −14 px it measures 44 px.

Settled by probe: "Is the lead's first notice visible without scrolling on a phone?" At 390×844 the demo lead card ends at 567 px and the first notice starts at 579 px, so about 200 px shows above the 64 px tab bar. In the worst case it starts at 653 px (about 127 px shows). At 320×700 it starts at 737 px, below the fold.

Rejected directions: (1) Inside the card, between the curve and the next easy week. That is a card in a card, and three long notices push Endre løpet and Bytt treningsform off the first screen. (2) Above the card. The warnings would come before the plan's own name, against ADR 0101 §2's order, and on every visit. (3) A one-line count in the card ("2 merknader ↓") with the full notices below. It is a second place to say the same thing, and it is new copy. Revisit only if a real phone shows the peek is missed. (4) A group heading ("Merknader om planen"). Each notice opens with its own fact, so a heading adds words and not meaning.

Code it touches: app/routes/training/plan.tsx (render the guards in the lead and pass them in). __plan-lead-card.tsx (a new notices slot after resting, inside [data-plan-lead]). __blocks-reading.tsx (remove the three notices, the derived warnings and the imports). __season-notices.tsx (a PlanGuardNotices({season}) owning the ramp flatMap and the three conditions in flex flex-col gap-3; DismissibleNotice drops mb-4; AlertDescription gets text-base md:text-sm; fact lines get text-foreground; links get the hit area). docs/adr/0101… §2 (the amendment). The mobile-overflow e2e (a plan with all three warnings). plan.route.test.tsx (notices inside [data-plan-lead], none in Blokker, the ?outline= plan's own warnings). labels.ts does not change.

Motion: none is added. Dismissal stays instant, as today: the space closing up is how a sighted reader sees the dismissal. The flex gap means a dismissed notice's sr-only line leaves no gap behind.

Needs a real phone: whether the peek above the tab bar is enough to read as "there is more", and how the invisible hit areas feel on the band session links.

Under the card Chosen

Working prototype. Use the picker (top) to flip between "I dag (før)" and "Under kortet". The controls on the right switch the data (Demo, Worst case, Ingen merknader) and the theme. Close a notice; open Avansert to see that Blokker no longer repeats the notices.

Worst case

The same prototype with the worst-case data (toggle inside). It shows long phase and event names, the lifting line, two day spans, a "Uke 52–1" wrap, the no-capacity link, clashes, four band sessions and the resting line.

Critic, what broke (report only): (1) Ugly: the 72 px gutter runs down every notice, leaving 268 of 358 px for text at 390 and 198 of 288 at 320. Fix: clear only the first line. (2) Fragile: band lines have no limit (seasonBandWarnings), so 24 off-band sessions make a notice of about 2,500 px. Fix: a follow-up that gives one line per block. (3) Fragile: at 320×700 no notice shows on the first screen. Check on a real phone. Everything else held: long names, "Uke 52–1", dark mode, 200 % zoom, no-warnings and dismissal.
